metadata.name: FinOps for Agents Dashboard
metadata.description: Monitor model prices and department-to-user-to-model token consumption for AI Foundry agents
metadata.author: FinOps Team

content.json:
# FinOps for Agents - Token Consumption Dashboard
**Real-time metrics for Microsoft Foundry AI Agent usage and costs**

content.query:
FinOpsAgentMetrics_CL
| where AgentName_s == "super-fun-coding-learn-agent"
| summarize TotalTokens = sum(TotalTokens_d) by UserDepartment_s
| sort by TotalTokens desc
content.title: Token Consumption by Department

content.query:
FinOpsAgentMetrics_CL
| where AgentName_s == "super-fun-coding-learn-agent"
| summarize TotalTokens = sum(TotalTokens_d) by UserDepartment_s
| sort by TotalTokens desc
content.title: Token Consumption Over Time

content.query:
FinOpsAgentMetrics_CL
| where AgentName_s == "super-fun-coding-learn-agent"
| summarize 
    TotalTokens = sum(TotalTokens_d),
    TotalCost = sum(EffectiveCost_d),
    RequestCount = count()
    by UserDepartment_s
| sort by TotalTokens desc
content.title: Department Summary

content.query:
let pricedUsage = FinOpsAgentMetrics_CL
| extend
    Model = iff(isempty(ModelId_s), "unknown", ModelId_s),
    InputTokens = todouble(InputTokens_d),
    CachedInputTokens = todouble(column_ifexists("CachedInputTokens_d", 0.0)),
    OutputTokens = todouble(OutputTokens_d),
    InputPriceUSDPer1M = todouble(column_ifexists("InputPricePerMillionTokens_d", real(null))),
    CachedInputPriceUSDPer1M = todouble(column_ifexists("CachedInputPricePerMillionTokens_d", real(null))),
    OutputPriceUSDPer1M = todouble(column_ifexists("OutputPricePerMillionTokens_d", real(null)))
| extend UncachedInputTokens = max_of(InputTokens - CachedInputTokens, 0.0);
let modelUsage = pricedUsage
| summarize
    UncachedInputTokens = sum(UncachedInputTokens),
    CachedInputTokens = sum(CachedInputTokens),
    OutputTokens = sum(OutputTokens),
    TotalTokens = sum(TotalTokens_d),
    TotalCost = sum(EffectiveCost_d),
    RequestCount = count()
    by Model;
let latestModelPrices = pricedUsage
| where isnotnull(InputPriceUSDPer1M)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, InputPriceUSDPer1M, CachedInputPriceUSDPer1M, OutputPriceUSDPer1M) by Model
| project Model, PriceObservedAt = TimeGenerated, InputPriceUSDPer1M, CachedInputPriceUSDPer1M, OutputPriceUSDPer1M;
modelUsage
| join kind=leftouter latestModelPrices on Model
| extend PriceStatus = iff(isnull(InputPriceUSDPer1M), "No priced telemetry yet", "Rate used by application")
| project Model, PriceStatus, PriceObservedAt, InputPriceUSDPer1M, CachedInputPriceUSDPer1M, OutputPriceUSDPer1M, UncachedInputTokens, CachedInputTokens, OutputTokens, TotalTokens, TotalCost, RequestCount
| order by TotalCost desc
content.title: Model Prices and Usage (USD per 1M tokens)
content.noDataMessage: No model usage exists in the selected time range.

content.query:
FinOpsAgentMetrics_CL
| extend
    Model = iff(isempty(ModelId_s), "unknown", ModelId_s),
    CachedInputTokens = todouble(column_ifexists("CachedInputTokens_d", 0.0)),
    InputTokens = todouble(InputTokens_d),
    OutputTokens = todouble(OutputTokens_d)
| extend UncachedInputTokens = max_of(InputTokens - CachedInputTokens, 0.0)
| summarize
    UncachedInputTokens = sum(UncachedInputTokens),
    CachedInputTokens = sum(CachedInputTokens),
    OutputTokens = sum(OutputTokens)
    by Model
| extend TotalTokens = UncachedInputTokens + CachedInputTokens + OutputTokens
| order by TotalTokens desc
| project-away TotalTokens
content.title: Token Consumption Grouped by Model
content.noDataMessage: No model usage exists in the selected time range.

content.query:
FinOpsAgentMetrics_CL
| extend
    CachedInputTokens = todouble(column_ifexists("CachedInputTokens_d", 0.0)),
    InputPriceUSDPer1M = todouble(column_ifexists("InputPricePerMillionTokens_d", real(null))),
    CachedInputPriceUSDPer1M = todouble(column_ifexists("CachedInputPricePerMillionTokens_d", real(null))),
    OutputPriceUSDPer1M = todouble(column_ifexists("OutputPricePerMillionTokens_d", real(null)))
| summarize
    TotalTokens = sum(TotalTokens_d),
    InputTokens = sum(InputTokens_d),
    CachedInputTokens = sum(CachedInputTokens),
    OutputTokens = sum(OutputTokens_d),
    TotalCost = sum(EffectiveCost_d),
    RequestCount = count(),
    arg_max(TimeGenerated, InputPriceUSDPer1M, CachedInputPriceUSDPer1M, OutputPriceUSDPer1M)
    by UserEmail = iff(isempty(UserEmail_s), "N/A", UserEmail_s), Model = ModelId_s
| project UserEmail, Model, InputPriceUSDPer1M, CachedInputPriceUSDPer1M, OutputPriceUSDPer1M, InputTokens, CachedInputTokens, OutputTokens, TotalTokens, TotalCost, RequestCount
| order by UserEmail asc, TotalCost desc
content.title: Usage and Cost by User and Model

content.query:
let usage = FinOpsAgentMetrics_CL
| extend
    Department = iff(isempty(UserDepartment_s), "N/A", UserDepartment_s),
    User = iff(isempty(UserEmail_s), "N/A", UserEmail_s),
    Model = iff(isempty(ModelId_s), "unknown", ModelId_s),
    CachedInputTokens = todouble(column_ifexists("CachedInputTokens_d", 0.0)),
    InputTokens = todouble(InputTokens_d),
    OutputTokens = todouble(OutputTokens_d)
| extend UncachedInputTokens = max_of(InputTokens - CachedInputTokens, 0.0)
| summarize
    UncachedInputTokens = sum(UncachedInputTokens),
    CachedInputTokens = sum(CachedInputTokens),
    OutputTokens = sum(OutputTokens)
    by Department, User, Model
| extend TotalTokens = UncachedInputTokens + CachedInputTokens + OutputTokens;
let departmentNodes = usage
| summarize Tokens = sum(TotalTokens) by Department
| project Id = strcat("department::", Department), Name = Department, Kind = "Department", Tokens;
let userNodes = usage
| summarize Tokens = sum(TotalTokens) by User
| project Id = strcat("user::", User), Name = User, Kind = "User", Tokens;
let modelNodes = usage
| summarize Tokens = sum(TotalTokens) by Model
| project Id = strcat("model::", Model), Name = Model, Kind = "Model", Tokens;
let tokenNodes = union
    (usage | summarize Tokens = sum(UncachedInputTokens) | extend Id = "token::input", Name = "Input tokens", Kind = "Token type"),
    (usage | summarize Tokens = sum(CachedInputTokens) | extend Id = "token::cached-input", Name = "Cached input tokens", Kind = "Token type"),
    (usage | summarize Tokens = sum(OutputTokens) | extend Id = "token::output", Name = "Output tokens", Kind = "Token type")
| where Tokens > 0
| project Id, Name, Kind, Tokens;
let departmentUserEdges = usage
| summarize Tokens = sum(TotalTokens) by Department, User
| where Tokens > 0
| project SourceId = strcat("department::", Department), TargetId = strcat("user::", User), Tokens, EdgeLabel = strcat(tostring(toint(Tokens)), " tokens");
let userModelEdges = usage
| summarize Tokens = sum(TotalTokens) by User, Model
| where Tokens > 0
| project SourceId = strcat("user::", User), TargetId = strcat("model::", Model), Tokens, EdgeLabel = strcat(tostring(toint(Tokens)), " tokens");
let modelTokenEdges = union
    (usage | summarize Tokens = sum(UncachedInputTokens) by Model | extend TargetId = "token::input"),
    (usage | summarize Tokens = sum(CachedInputTokens) by Model | extend TargetId = "token::cached-input"),
    (usage | summarize Tokens = sum(OutputTokens) by Model | extend TargetId = "token::output")
| where Tokens > 0
| extend SourceId = strcat("model::", Model), EdgeLabel = strcat(tostring(toint(Tokens)), " tokens")
| project SourceId, TargetId, Tokens, EdgeLabel;
departmentNodes
| union userNodes, modelNodes, tokenNodes, departmentUserEdges, userModelEdges, modelTokenEdges
content.title: Department to User to Model to Token Consumption Flow
content.noDataMessage: No department, user, and model usage exists in the selected time range.
